> **Scope note:** Palim keeps its surface intentionally small: agent or Markdown authoring, one deterministic EPUB publisher, one byte-identical EPUB/PDF forwarding path, and Cloudflare Email delivery. It does not run an authoring model, index repositories, or sync Kindle libraries.

## Problem

What reader, author, or self-hosting obligation is blocked or unclear today?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest change that solves it and which surface owns it (publisher, forwarding, MCP, web studio, docs).

## Verification

How can this behaviour be verified deterministically or in an independent check?
